scope.unit: One entry per meaningful user intent; equivalent controls with the same effect are represented as variants or multiple triggers.
includes: Cadence-owned pointer, keyboard, and touch triggers
Confirmation inputs that gate a user action
excludes: Passive scrolling, hover, focus, and text selection
Browser-native permission, file-picker, save-dialog, and download-shelf controls
Google and other provider-owned user interfaces
Planned or deferred interactions without a user-facing implementation

source_inventory.reason: Local dev-only component bench, not a product surface.

interactions.name: Start Google sign-in
interactions.intent: Authenticate with Google and enter the protected app.
interactions.availability: Available when public Supabase runtime configuration is present.
interactions.success_result: Starts Supabase Google OAuth and returns the signed-in user to the sanitized next route, normally /timeline.
interactions.failure_result: Returns to /login with a factual, recoverable authentication error.

test_coverage.notes: The login test renders the Google control and its sanitized next destination; route behavior is covered separately and provider-owned UI remains outside scope.

interactions.name: Continue as a temporary test user
interactions.intent: Enter the app with a disposable local QA account.
interactions.availability: Only visible in explicitly enabled non-production localhost QA environments.
interactions.success_result: Creates or signs in a disposable test account and navigates to the sanitized next route.
interactions.failure_result: Refuses access when any environment, host, or hosted-project safety gate is not satisfied.

test_coverage.notes: The login test renders the temporary-user control behind its local QA gate; route safety remains covered separately.

interactions.name: Open public information before sign-in
interactions.intent: Review Terms, Privacy, Trust, or the Cadence overview before authenticating.

triggers.control: Terms, Privacy, Trust, or How Cadence works link

interactions.availability: Always available on the public login page.
interactions.success_result: Opens the selected public information destination.
interactions.failure_result: Normal navigation failure behavior applies.

test_coverage.notes: The login test renders and asserts all four public information links.

interactions.name: Switch public account-information page
interactions.intent: Move between Terms, Privacy, and Trust while reading public account information.
interactions.availability: Available on every public account-information page.
interactions.success_result: Loads the selected page and marks it as current in the legal navigation.
interactions.failure_result: Normal navigation failure behavior applies.

test_coverage.notes: Page ordering, content, and route links are automated.

interactions.name: Leave a public account-information page
interactions.intent: Continue to the Cadence overview, sign in, or return to Settings.

triggers.control: Cadence overview, Sign in, or Open settings footer link

variants.label: Cadence overview
variants.result: Open the public marketing product page.

variants.label: Open settings
variants.result: Navigate to /settings or be redirected to sign in when unauthenticated.

interactions.availability: Available in the footer of each public account-information page.
interactions.success_result: Navigates to the selected destination.
interactions.failure_result: Normal internal or external navigation failure behavior applies.

test_coverage.notes: Footer destinations are asserted.

interactions.name: Skip marketing navigation
interactions.intent: Move keyboard focus directly to the main page content.
interactions.availability: Available as the first focusable link on marketing pages.
interactions.success_result: Moves the URL fragment and focus target to the main content landmark.
interactions.failure_result: No material side effect if fragment navigation is unsupported.

test_coverage.notes: Covered by marketing accessibility QA.

interactions.name: Open marketing home from the brand
interactions.intent: Return to the Cadence marketing homepage.

interactions.success_result: Navigates to the marketing homepage.
interactions.failure_result: Normal navigation failure behavior applies.

test_coverage.notes: Verified through marketing route QA.

interactions.name: Use primary marketing navigation
interactions.intent: Open the Cadence product or BehaviorLog overview from the header.
interactions.availability: Available in the marketing header.
interactions.success_result: Loads the selected marketing route.
interactions.failure_result: Normal navigation failure behavior applies.

test_coverage.notes: Verified through marketing route QA.

interactions.name: Open Cadence sign-in from marketing
interactions.intent: Move from the public marketing site to the authenticated product entry point.

interactions.success_result: Opens the deployed Cadence /login route.

test_coverage.notes: Deployment URL is checked during marketing QA.

interactions.name: Use marketing footer navigation

interactions.availability: Available in the marketing footer.
interactions.success_result: Opens the selected internal or external destination.
interactions.failure_result: Normal internal or external navigation failure behavior applies.

test_coverage.notes: Marketing build and route QA cover these destinations.

interactions.name: Try Cadence
interactions.intent: Open the Cadence product from a marketing call to action.
interactions.availability: Available on the marketing homepage and FAQ page.
interactions.success_result: Opens the deployed Cadence product entry route.
interactions.failure_result: External navigation failure leaves the marketing page unchanged.

test_coverage.notes: Verified in public discovery walkthroughs.

test_coverage.notes: Verified in public discovery walkthroughs.

interactions.name: Open a project repository

test_coverage.notes: External destinations are checked during marketing QA.

interactions.name: Download the example BehaviorLog bundle
interactions.intent: Download the sanitized example bundle for inspection or parser testing.

triggers.control: Download Example Bundle or direct download link

interactions.success_result: Starts a download of the build-generated .behaviorlog.zip example.

test_coverage.notes: The marketing check validates the built example artifact and route; activating the download control remains browser QA.

interactions.name: Open a machine-readable marketing resource
interactions.intent: Inspect the route manifest, agent index, Markdown mirrors, or other machine-readable site output.

interactions.failure_result: Normal fragment or route navigation failure behavior applies.

test_coverage.notes: Verified through marketing route and anchor QA.

interactions.name: Navigate between primary app screens

interactions.success_result: Loads the selected protected route and closes the mobile drawer when applicable.
interactions.failure_result: An invalid session redirects to /login with the requested route preserved.

test_coverage.notes: The app-shell test renders all four primary navigation destinations in the owning shell.

interactions.name: Open Timeline from the app brand
interactions.intent: Return to the primary Timeline screen from the Cadence brand.
interactions.availability: Available in the desktop rail, mobile header, and mobile drawer.
interactions.success_result: Navigates to /timeline and closes or expands the relevant navigation shell state.
interactions.failure_result: Normal navigation failure behavior applies.

test_coverage.notes: The app-shell test renders the Timeline brand destinations and accessible names; detailed state transitions remain browser-tested.

interactions.name: Open account settings
interactions.intent: Open Settings from the account row in the app shell.
interactions.availability: Available to authenticated users in desktop and mobile navigation.
interactions.success_result: Navigates to /settings and closes the mobile drawer when applicable.
interactions.failure_result: An invalid session redirects to /login.

test_coverage.notes: Covered by authenticated shell walkthroughs.

interactions.name: Toggle the desktop navigation rail
interactions.intent: Collapse or expand the fixed desktop navigation rail.

variants.label: Collapse navigation
variants.result: Collapse the expanded desktop navigation rail.

variants.label: Expand navigation
variants.result: Expand the collapsed desktop navigation rail without navigating.

interactions.availability: Available at desktop widths; the separate collapse button is visible while expanded and the top icon cell is an expand-only button while collapsed.
interactions.success_result: Changes rail width and persists the preference in localStorage when available.
interactions.failure_result: The rail still changes for the current session if localStorage is unavailable.

test_coverage.notes: The app-shell test renders the collapsed header as Expand navigation and verifies that its brand cell is no longer a Timeline destination.

interactions.name: Open mobile navigation
interactions.intent: Open the mobile navigation drawer.

triggers.control: Right swipe beginning within the first 20px of the viewport

interactions.availability: Available below the desktop breakpoint.
interactions.success_result: Opens the drawer, traps focus inside it, and locks body scrolling.
interactions.failure_result: A non-horizontal or short gesture is ignored.

test_coverage.notes: Pointer, focus, and touch behavior require browser QA.

interactions.name: Close mobile navigation
interactions.intent: Dismiss the open mobile navigation drawer.

triggers.control: Left swipe while the drawer is open

interactions.availability: Available while the mobile drawer is open.
interactions.success_result: Closes the drawer, unlocks body scrolling, and restores prior focus when navigation did not replace the page.
interactions.failure_result: A non-horizontal or short gesture is ignored.

test_coverage.notes: Keyboard, backdrop, navigation, and touch paths require browser QA.

interactions.name: Preview the login screen while authenticated
interactions.intent: Inspect the login screen during local development without ending the current session.
interactions.availability: Visible in the app shell only outside production.
interactions.success_result: Navigates to the login preview with the current protected path preserved as next.
interactions.failure_result: Production or unsupported preview requests follow normal authenticated redirect behavior.

test_coverage.notes: Local preview routing is partly covered by proxy tests and browser QA.

interactions.name: Sign out
interactions.intent: End the current authenticated Cadence session, including before leaving a shared device.
interactions.availability: Available directly below the account row in the expanded desktop rail, collapsed desktop rail, and mobile drawer.
interactions.success_result: Ends the session and redirects to /login with the signed-out status.
interactions.failure_result: Shows a factual recoverable error and leaves the session state unchanged.

test_coverage.notes: The app-shell test renders the POST-only Sign out control in every shell presentation; route and focused-result behavior are covered separately.

interactions.name: Dismiss first-run setup
interactions.intent: Hide the optional first-run setup pop-up in the current browser.
interactions.availability: Available while the setup pop-up is visible.
interactions.success_result: Hides the pop-up and records the dismissal in localStorage when available.
interactions.failure_result: The pop-up still hides for the current render if localStorage is unavailable.

test_coverage.notes: Notification-state handling is automated, but rendering and activating the client-only dismissal controls remains browser QA.

interactions.name: Open a first-run setup task
interactions.intent: Continue from setup to the existing product control that owns the selected task.

triggers.control: Create behavior, Enable notifications, Confirm timezone, or Import data setup row

interactions.availability: A row is actionable while its corresponding setup task is available for review.
interactions.success_result: Navigates to the existing owning screen and fragment without performing the task automatically.
interactions.failure_result: Normal navigation failure behavior applies.

test_coverage.notes: Task resolution and client-state handling are automated, but activating the client-only setup links remains browser QA.

interactions.name: Show more future days
interactions.intent: Reveal more generated future Timeline days.
interactions.availability: Available while the current visible-day count is below the generated horizon.
interactions.success_result: Navigates to the same Timeline with a larger bounded days query while preserving useful scroll context.
interactions.failure_result: Invalid day values are normalized to the supported range.

test_coverage.notes: The Timeline UI test renders the bounded Show more days destination.

interactions.name: Open Needs decision
interactions.intent: Review prior unresolved occurrences and same-day retained corrections.

triggers.control: Needs decision or Review today's decisions floating button

interactions.availability: Available when unresolved prior-day rows or same-day retained prior decisions exist.
interactions.success_result: Opens the modal, moves focus into it, and locks background scrolling.
interactions.failure_result: No modal launcher is rendered when no reviewable groups exist.

test_coverage.notes: The Timeline UI test renders the Needs decision launcher and its accessible name.

interactions.name: Close Needs decision
interactions.intent: Return from the Needs decision modal to the forward Timeline.
interactions.availability: Available while the Needs decision modal is open.
interactions.success_result: Closes the modal, unlocks background scrolling, and restores focus to the launcher.
interactions.failure_result: No effect when the modal is already closed.

test_coverage.notes: Structure is automated; focus restoration and Escape behavior are browser-verified.

interactions.name: Toggle occurrence details
interactions.intent: Reveal or hide an occurrence description, category, schedule, correction controls, and Note field.

triggers.control: Occurrence row summary outside its status actions

interactions.availability: Available for every rendered Timeline or Needs decision occurrence row.
interactions.success_result: Toggles the native details element without changing occurrence data.
interactions.failure_result: No data side effect occurs if disclosure state cannot change.

test_coverage.notes: The Timeline UI test renders the occurrence details disclosure and its content.

interactions.name: Set an occurrence to Completed
interactions.intent: Record or correct the occurrence status as Completed.
interactions.availability: Available on unresolved rows and inside expanded correction controls; behavior date review also exposes it.
interactions.success_result: Atomically updates the occurrence snapshot, appends the status event when the choice changes, cancels pending reminders as planned, refreshes the view, and attempts the completion chime at most once for a new Completed transition.
interactions.failure_result: Rolls back optimistic presentation and shows a factual error; no partial status write is retained.

test_coverage.notes: Timeline UI coverage renders the Completed control. The mobile activation harness preserves one submission, one guarded preparation, one media playback attempt, and one playback-start event; transition and persistence behavior are covered separately.

interactions.name: Set an occurrence to Not Completed
interactions.intent: Record or correct the occurrence status as Not Completed.
interactions.availability: Available on unresolved rows and inside expanded correction controls; behavior date review also exposes it.
interactions.success_result: Atomically updates the occurrence snapshot, appends the status event when the choice changes, cancels pending reminders as planned, and refreshes the view without playing a completion sound.
interactions.failure_result: Rolls back optimistic presentation and shows a factual error; no partial status write is retained.

test_coverage.notes: The Timeline UI test renders the Not Completed submission control; transition and persistence behavior are covered separately.

interactions.name: Clear a submitted occurrence decision
interactions.intent: Return a resolved occurrence to Unresolved, either as an immediate Timeline correction or during deliberate behavior date review.
interactions.availability: Unmark is available on an expanded, just-decided Timeline occurrence; Clear decision is available inside the Review disclosure for a resolved behavior-date occurrence.
interactions.success_result: Atomically changes the occurrence to Unresolved, appends a correction event, refreshes the owning view, and restores only reminders that are still future.
interactions.failure_result: Shows a factual error and preserves the current resolved state.

test_coverage.notes: The Timeline UI test renders the Unmark correction control; transition and reminder behavior are covered separately.

interactions.name: Save an occurrence note
interactions.intent: Add, replace, or clear free-text context on one occurrence.
interactions.availability: Available inside expanded Timeline/Needs decision rows and behavior date Review disclosures.
interactions.success_result: Updates only the occurrence Note and refreshes the owning surface without changing status timestamps or status history.
interactions.failure_result: Shows a factual error and preserves the stored note.

test_coverage.notes: The Timeline UI test renders the Note field and Save note submission control; note persistence is covered separately.

interactions.name: Track occurrence time
interactions.intent: Start, stop, or reset elapsed time captured for one occurrence.
interactions.availability: Track Time is available for an active behavior's current-local-day occurrence or an occurrence still visible in Needs decision. Future occurrences, archived behaviors, and prior resolved occurrences outside the Needs decision retention window cannot start. Stop and Reset tracked time remain available for a persisted running or recorded session. Behaviors exposes Reset tracked time only inside Review for an occurrence with timing data.
interactions.success_result: Persists one start or stop interval, or deletes every interval for the occurrence. Timeline and Behaviors refresh without changing occurrence status or reminders.
interactions.failure_result: Shows a factual inline error and preserves the saved timing sessions.

test_coverage.notes: Timeline UI coverage renders idle, running, stopped, and Needs decision timing controls. Behaviors UI coverage renders its reset control. Timing resolver and service tests cover eligibility and idempotent persistence.

interactions.name: Refresh Timeline on mobile
interactions.intent: Request current Timeline data with one deliberate mobile pull gesture.

triggers.control: Downward pull from the top of Timeline followed by release

interactions.availability: Available at mobile widths while the document is at its scroll top, the gesture starts outside a status, Note, timing, navigation, or Needs decision control, and no refresh is already in flight.
interactions.success_result: Shows bounded pull feedback and requests current Timeline data exactly once without mutating an occurrence.
interactions.failure_result: Short, horizontal, cancelled, below-the-top, desktop, control-started, or duplicate in-flight gestures preserve the current view without refreshing.

test_coverage.notes: Automated coverage proves threshold, direction lock, control exclusion, cancellation, one in-flight refresh claim, native-refresh suppression, and wrapper rendering. Physical touch dispatch and router completion remain browser QA.

interactions.name: Change the behavior review range
interactions.intent: Review behavior and adherence data over the last 7, 30, or 90 days.

triggers.control: 7 days, 30 days, or 90 days range link

interactions.availability: Always available in Overall adherence.
interactions.success_result: Updates the range query and recalculates summary, heatmaps, and behavior rows while retaining a valid selected behavior day.
interactions.failure_result: Unsupported range values normalize to the default range.

test_coverage.notes: The behavior-review UI test renders all three range destinations.

interactions.name: Open a behavior day review
interactions.intent: Review one behavior's occurrences on a selected non-empty calendar day.
interactions.availability: Available only for a behavior calendar cell containing at least one occurrence.
interactions.success_result: Updates the query and renders Review selected day inside the owning behavior row.
interactions.failure_result: Empty cells remain passive; invalid selections do not render an empty review panel.

test_coverage.notes: The behavior-review UI test renders actionable heatmap cells and the selected-day review.

interactions.name: Toggle occurrence correction controls in behavior review
interactions.intent: Reveal or hide status and Note controls for one reviewed occurrence.
interactions.availability: Available for each occurrence in Review selected day.
interactions.success_result: Toggles the native disclosure without changing stored occurrence data.
interactions.failure_result: No data side effect occurs if disclosure state cannot change.

test_coverage.notes: Review disclosure structure and controls are covered.

interactions.name: Toggle the create behavior form
interactions.intent: Reveal or hide the create behavior form.
interactions.availability: Available on Behaviors; it may start open when no active behavior exists.
interactions.success_result: Toggles the native disclosure and clears prior success copy when reopening.
interactions.failure_result: No stored product data changes.

test_coverage.notes: The behavior UI test renders the Create behavior disclosure and open form.

interactions.name: Toggle behavior Details and Settings
interactions.intent: Review behavior configuration and load the edit form.
interactions.availability: Available on active and archived behavior rows.
interactions.success_result: Toggles the native disclosure and lazily mounts the edit form after first opening.
interactions.failure_result: No stored product data changes.

test_coverage.notes: The behavior-review UI test renders the Details and Settings disclosure.

interactions.name: Toggle archived behaviors
interactions.intent: Reveal or hide the low-priority archived behavior list.
interactions.availability: Always available at the bottom of Behaviors, including when the archived count is zero.
interactions.success_result: Toggles the native disclosure without changing behavior state.
interactions.failure_result: No stored product data changes.

test_coverage.notes: Archived disclosure rendering is covered.

interactions.name: Edit behavior identity fields
interactions.intent: Set a behavior title, optional description, and optional category in a create or edit draft.
interactions.availability: Available in open create and edit forms.
interactions.success_result: Updates only the client form draft until Save behavior is submitted.
interactions.failure_result: Required and server validation errors remain attached to their fields after submission.

test_coverage.notes: The behavior UI test renders the title, description, and category controls.

interactions.name: Choose a recurrence pattern
interactions.intent: Choose Daily, Every few days, Weekly, or Monthly for one behavior schedule draft.

variants.label: Weekly
variants.result: Show week interval and weekday fields.

variants.label: Monthly
variants.result: Show month interval and day fields.

interactions.availability: Available for every schedule row in an open behavior form.
interactions.success_result: Changes the recurrence-specific draft controls without writing product data.
interactions.failure_result: Server validation rejects unsupported or incomplete recurrence data on save.

test_coverage.notes: The behavior UI test renders the recurrence-kind control in the owning form.

interactions.name: Configure recurrence details
interactions.intent: Set interval, selected weekdays, or monthly day for one schedule draft.
interactions.availability: Available according to the recurrence pattern selected for the schedule row.
interactions.success_result: Updates the recurrence draft; monthly day values up to 31 use the documented last-day fallback after save.
interactions.failure_result: Server validation rejects invalid intervals, dates, or empty weekly selections.

test_coverage.notes: The behavior UI test renders the recurrence detail controls for weekly and monthly schedules.

interactions.name: Add a behavior schedule
interactions.intent: Add another recurrence pattern with an initial time to the behavior draft.
interactions.availability: Available while fewer than six schedule rows exist.
interactions.success_result: Adds a Daily schedule draft with an initial exact time.
interactions.failure_result: The control is disabled at the schedule-row limit.

test_coverage.notes: The behavior UI test renders the Add schedule control.

interactions.name: Remove a behavior schedule
interactions.intent: Remove one recurrence pattern from the unsaved behavior draft.
interactions.availability: Available only when the draft contains more than one schedule.
interactions.success_result: Removes the selected schedule draft; persistence changes only after Save behavior.
interactions.failure_result: The last remaining schedule cannot be removed.

test_coverage.notes: The behavior UI test renders Remove schedule when the form has multiple schedules.

interactions.name: Choose a schedule time mode
interactions.intent: Represent one schedule time as an exact time or a time range.

triggers.control: Exact time or Time range select

variants.label: Time range
variants.result: Show preset/custom range controls initialized to Morning.

interactions.availability: Available for each time entry in an open behavior form.
interactions.success_result: Changes the time-entry draft mode and relevant fields.
interactions.failure_result: Server validation rejects incomplete or invalid time values on save.

test_coverage.notes: The behavior UI test renders exact-time and range-mode controls.

interactions.name: Edit a schedule time
interactions.intent: Set an exact HH:MM time, choose a named range, or enter custom range endpoints.

triggers.control: Exact time, range start, or range end field

variants.label: Custom range
variants.result: Show and update start and end HH:MM fields.

interactions.availability: Available according to the selected time-entry mode.
interactions.success_result: Updates the time-entry draft without writing product data.
interactions.failure_result: Server validation rejects malformed, reversed, or incomplete time data on save.

test_coverage.notes: The behavior UI test renders exact-time and range-preset inputs.

interactions.name: Add a time to a behavior schedule
interactions.intent: Add another time entry under the same recurrence pattern.
interactions.availability: Available while the schedule contains fewer than eight time entries.
interactions.success_result: Adds a new exact-time draft after the current entries.
interactions.failure_result: The control is disabled at the time-entry limit.

test_coverage.notes: The behavior UI test renders the Add time control.

interactions.name: Remove a schedule time
interactions.intent: Remove one time entry from the unsaved schedule draft.
interactions.availability: Available only when the schedule contains more than one time entry.
interactions.success_result: Removes the selected time draft; persistence changes only after Save behavior.
interactions.failure_result: The last remaining time entry cannot be removed.

test_coverage.notes: The behavior UI test renders Remove time when a schedule has multiple entries.

interactions.name: Set behavior browser-reminder intent
interactions.intent: Enable or disable browser-reminder planning for one behavior.
interactions.availability: Available in create and edit behavior forms; enabled by default for new behaviors.
interactions.success_result: Updates the form draft; Save behavior persists the intent and replans future reminders.
interactions.failure_result: Device permission is not requested here and the behavior remains trackable if delivery is unavailable.

test_coverage.notes: The reminder-editor UI test renders the browser-reminder checkbox.

interactions.name: Set behavior email-reminder intent
interactions.intent: Enable or disable email reminder planning for one behavior.
interactions.availability: Available in create and edit behavior forms; disabled by default for new behaviors.
interactions.success_result: Updates the form draft; Save behavior persists the intent and replans future reminders.
interactions.failure_result: No email is sent from this control; delivery depends on later reminder processing.

test_coverage.notes: The reminder-editor UI test renders the email-reminder checkbox.

interactions.name: Choose the behavior reminder offset
interactions.intent: Choose when enabled behavior reminders should be due relative to a scheduled occurrence.
interactions.availability: Available in create and edit behavior forms.
interactions.success_result: Updates the form draft; Save behavior persists the offset and replans eligible future reminder deliveries.
interactions.failure_result: Unsupported values are rejected during server validation.

test_coverage.notes: The reminder-editor UI test renders the reminder-offset select.

interactions.name: Create a behavior
interactions.intent: Persist a new recurring behavior and its schedule graph.
interactions.availability: Available when the create form is open and required browser validation passes.
interactions.success_result: Atomically creates the owned behavior, initial definition event, schedules, and time slots; marks occurrence and reminder coverage stale; closes and resets the form; adds the behavior row to the UI; and immediately attempts occurrence and reminder repair without overturning the durable save if retryable repair fails.
interactions.failure_result: Shows field or form errors without creating a partial behavior graph.

test_coverage.notes: The behavior UI test renders Save behavior in create mode; validation and atomic persistence are covered separately.

interactions.name: Update a behavior
interactions.intent: Persist edits to an existing behavior definition, schedules, time slots, and reminder settings.
interactions.availability: Available inside an opened behavior Details and Settings edit form.
interactions.success_result: Atomically updates the owner-scoped behavior graph, appends a definition event when title or description changed, marks occurrence and reminder coverage stale, and immediately attempts repair without overturning the durable save if retryable repair fails.
interactions.failure_result: Shows field or form errors and preserves the last stored behavior graph.

test_coverage.notes: The behavior UI test renders Save behavior in edit mode; graph persistence and sync invalidation are covered separately.

interactions.name: Reset unsaved behavior changes
interactions.intent: Discard current unsaved field values in a create or edit behavior form.
interactions.availability: Available in open create and edit behavior forms.
interactions.success_result: Restores the complete create or edit draft to the values present when the form opened, including identity, recurrence, schedule and time rows, reminder choices, and active state; no server action or product write occurs.
interactions.failure_result: No product data is written; a client rendering failure leaves the last stored behavior unchanged.

test_coverage.notes: Draft-reset helpers and form structure are automated; complete browser-native reset behavior remains manual QA.

interactions.name: Archive a behavior
interactions.intent: Make an active behavior inactive without deleting its history.
interactions.availability: Available at the end of Details and Settings for an active behavior.
interactions.success_result: Atomically marks the behavior inactive with a durable occurrence/reminder stale marker, preserves history, immediately moves the row to Archived behaviors, and attempts occurrence and reminder repair; retryable repair failure does not overturn the committed archive.
interactions.failure_result: A transaction failure shows a factual error and leaves the behavior active; a post-commit repair failure remains queued by the durable stale marker.

test_coverage.notes: Archive persistence and sync invalidation are automated, but the lazily mounted Archive behavior control remains browser QA.

interactions.name: Restore an archived behavior
interactions.intent: Return an archived behavior to the active behavior set.
interactions.availability: Available on behavior rows inside Archived behaviors.
interactions.success_result: Atomically marks the behavior active with a durable occurrence/reminder stale marker, immediately moves the row to Active behaviors, and attempts to regenerate occurrences and eligible reminders; retryable repair failure does not overturn the committed restore.
interactions.failure_result: A transaction failure shows a factual error and leaves the behavior archived; a post-commit repair failure remains queued by the durable stale marker.

test_coverage.notes: The behavior-review UI test renders the Restore submission control; state and sync behavior are covered separately.

interactions.name: Choose an export range
interactions.intent: Choose Last 7 days, Last 30 days, Last 90 days, or All time for every export output.
interactions.availability: Always available in Export Options.

interactions.failure_result: Unsupported values normalize through the export resolver.

test_coverage.notes: The export-panel UI test renders every export range option.

interactions.name: Include or exclude archived behaviors from exports

interactions.availability: Always available in Export Options.
interactions.success_result: Updates the options draft; after apply, counts and all outputs use the selected inclusion rule.
interactions.failure_result: The last applied query remains authoritative if option submission fails.

test_coverage.notes: The export-panel UI test renders the archived-behavior inclusion control.

interactions.name: Include or exclude occurrence notes from exports

interactions.name: Apply export options

interactions.failure_result: Invalid query values normalize to safe defaults.

interactions.name: Download a structured export
interactions.intent: Download the currently scoped data in a supported machine-readable format.

variants.label: BehaviorLog bundle
variants.result: Download the interoperability and restore-oriented ZIP bundle.

interactions.availability: Available after the Export page loads successfully.
interactions.success_result: The authenticated export API returns a downloadable artifact using the applied query options.
interactions.failure_result: Invalid auth, a six-per-minute account limit, an open export circuit breaker, or export failure returns a stable HTTP error without a partial artifact. Rate limits include Retry-After guidance.

test_coverage.notes: The export-panel UI test renders each structured download destination. The route-adapter test covers authenticated failure, stable 429 Retry-After, and scoped breaker responses without partial downloads; format integrity and conformance are covered separately.

interactions.name: Copy the Markdown AI summary

interactions.name: Copy an analysis prompt

interactions.failure_result: Announces Copy unavailable without changing product data.

test_coverage.notes: The prompt-library UI test renders the named Copy prompt control and status region.

interactions.name: Preview a BehaviorLog import
interactions.intent: Upload a BehaviorLog bundle and inspect a read-only create/merge safety plan.
interactions.availability: Available in the BehaviorLog import section for authenticated users with a .behaviorlog.zip bundle no larger than 2 MB.
interactions.success_result: Parses and validates the bundle, gathers current owned data, persists the preview run, and renders counts, warnings, conflicts, privacy notes, fingerprints, and supported apply modes without product writes.
interactions.failure_result: Shows validation or processing errors and exposes no apply control for an unsafe preview.

test_coverage.notes: The import UI test renders the bundle upload and Preview import controls.

interactions.name: Acknowledge the exact accepted import preview
interactions.intent: Confirm that the user reviewed the exact persisted import preview being applied.

triggers.control: I reviewed this exact preview checkbox

interactions.availability: Available in each supported import apply form after a valid preview.
interactions.success_result: Satisfies one required apply gate; it performs no product write by itself.
interactions.failure_result: Apply submission is rejected when the acknowledgement is absent.

test_coverage.notes: The import UI test renders the exact-preview acknowledgement gate.

interactions.name: Acknowledge sensitive imported notes
interactions.intent: Confirm review of high or restricted note sensitivity warnings before import apply.

triggers.control: I reviewed high or restricted note sensitivity warnings checkbox

interactions.availability: Required only when the accepted import preview contains high or restricted notes that would be imported.
interactions.success_result: Satisfies the sensitive-note apply gate; it performs no product write by itself.
interactions.failure_result: Apply submission is rejected when required acknowledgement is absent.

test_coverage.notes: The import UI test renders the conditional sensitive-note acknowledgement gate.

interactions.name: Apply a BehaviorLog import
interactions.intent: Write the supported create-only or safe merge actions from the exact accepted preview.

variants.label: Apply create-only import
variants.result: Create supported records without mapping onto existing records.

variants.label: Apply approved merge
variants.result: Apply only supported create, map, and skip actions from the accepted merge preview.

interactions.availability: Enabled only for a valid supported preview with exact-preview acknowledgement and any required sensitivity acknowledgement.
interactions.success_result: Verifies the persisted preview identity and all fingerprints, writes the supported owner-scoped records, and records the applied import run and mappings.
interactions.failure_result: Rejects stale, altered, mismatched, unaccepted, unsafe, or unsupported plans without silently recomputing a replacement plan.

test_coverage.notes: The import UI test renders both apply variants and their required gates; write semantics are covered separately.

interactions.name: Preview a BehaviorLog restore
interactions.intent: Upload a trusted BehaviorLog backup and inspect a read-only restore plan.
interactions.availability: Available in the BehaviorLog restore section for authenticated users with a trusted .behaviorlog.zip bundle no larger than 2 MB.
interactions.success_result: Parses and validates the bundle, gathers current owned data, persists the preview run, and renders create/replace/archive/delete/keep/skip actions, destructive counts, boundaries, warnings, and fingerprints without product writes.
interactions.failure_result: Shows validation or processing errors and does not enable restore apply.

test_coverage.notes: The restore UI test renders the trusted bundle upload and Preview restore controls.

interactions.name: Acknowledge a fresh backup before restore

interactions.availability: Available in Apply restore after a valid supported preview.
interactions.success_result: Satisfies one required restore gate; it performs no product write by itself.
interactions.failure_result: Restore submission is rejected when the acknowledgement is absent.

test_coverage.notes: The restore UI test renders the fresh-backup acknowledgement gate.

interactions.name: Acknowledge sensitive restored notes

interactions.success_result: Satisfies the sensitive-note restore gate; it performs no product write by itself.
interactions.failure_result: Restore submission is rejected when required acknowledgement is absent.

test_coverage.notes: The restore UI test renders the conditional sensitive-note acknowledgement gate.

interactions.name: Type restore confirmation

interactions.failure_result: Restore submission is rejected for missing or non-matching text.

test_coverage.notes: The restore UI test renders the required typed confirmation gate.

interactions.name: Apply a BehaviorLog restore
interactions.intent: Apply the exact accepted restore preview to owned Cadence product records.
interactions.availability: Enabled only for a valid supported preview with fresh-backup acknowledgement, exact RESTORE text, and any required sensitivity acknowledgement.
interactions.success_result: Revalidates the canonical bundle and stale-row preconditions, then atomically applies create/replace/archive/delete/keep decisions, definition history, provenance, and applied ledger entries without provider calls.
interactions.failure_result: Rejects stale, altered, mismatched, skipped, unsupported, or unconfirmed restore input without partial product writes.

test_coverage.notes: The restore UI test renders Apply restore behind every required gate; atomic apply and stale refusal are covered separately.

interactions.name: Choose a timezone

interactions.failure_result: The control is absent when detection is unavailable or already matches.

test_coverage.notes: Service impact is automated; browser Intl detection is manually verified.

interactions.name: Save the account timezone

interactions.failure_result: Shows a factual validation or service error and preserves the stored timezone and schedule graph.

test_coverage.notes: The Settings UI test renders Save timezone; propagation and historical preservation are covered separately.

interactions.name: Enable or refresh browser notifications on this device

interactions.name: Delete the signed-in account
interactions.intent: Permanently remove the signed-in Cadence account and its hosted owned records.
interactions.availability: Enabled only when the export acknowledgement and exact typed confirmation are both present and no deletion is pending.
interactions.success_result: Server revalidates both gates, signs out globally, deletes the Supabase Auth user through server-only credentials, relies on ownership cascades to delete hosted records, and redirects to the public login confirmation.
interactions.failure_result: Shows a factual error and preserves the account when validation, sign-out, or deletion fails.

test_coverage.notes: The Settings UI test renders Delete account behind the acknowledgement and typed gates; destructive service behavior is covered separately.

interactions.name: Open Cadence from a delivered browser notification
interactions.intent: Open the occurrence review target from a delivered Cadence browser notification.
interactions.availability: Available after a Cadence browser notification is delivered; protected routes may require the user to sign in again.
interactions.success_result: Closes the notification, navigates an existing same-origin Cadence window to the notification target and focuses it, or opens the target in a new window when no Cadence window exists.
interactions.failure_result: Cross-origin targets fall back to /timeline; normal browser window-opening or protected-route sign-in behavior applies.

test_coverage.notes: Existing-window navigation/focus and new-window opening are executed against the service worker source.
